run_display_data_task: run the display_data script to print examples from a ParlAI task like babi:task1k:1
run_display_data_num_examples: run display_data with a custom number of examples using the --num-examples flag
run_display_data_verbose: run display_data in verbose mode to show all fields including label_candidates and beam_texts
setup_args_display_data: setup the argument parser for display_data with options for num-examples and max-display-len
review_simple_display: review the simple_display function that prints episode text and labels from a ParlAI world
